home.title: Tauri + Next.js Template
home.description: Desktop shell with a main window, modal sub-window, i18n, and cross-webview session sync. Replace this page with your app.

console.wework_connect_required: Connect WeCom under Account & channel before using the inbox.
console.wework_accounts_desc: Save WeCom profiles and connect manually when needed. Successful connections are saved to the list.
console.wework_accounts_empty: No saved accounts yet. Tap New connection below.
console.wework_account_delete_confirm: Remove this saved account from the list?
console.wework_account_switch_message: Currently connected to "{{current}}". Disconnect and connect to "{{target}}"?
console.wework_accounts_backend_offline: Channel service is unavailable. Saved accounts are shown below; connect and switch when the service is back.
console.wework_placeholder_body: This page will connect to CowAgent settings. Placeholder for now.
console.wework_inbox_composer_hint: Demo data; sending will work after IPC is wired
console.wework_detail_empty: Select a conversation to see details
console.wework_detail_mock_hint: Demo data. One group = one session via wework:{conversationId}.
console.welcome_subtitle: I can help you answer questions, manage your computer, create skills, and grow through memory and knowledge.
console.example_task_text: Remind me to check the server in 1 minute
console.example_code_text: Search AI news and build a visual report
console.placeholder_body: This feature is not wired to the Rust agent yet. Use Chat, Config, and Skills to test.
console.send_failed: Send failed. Check src-tauri/resources/config.json and API key.
console.api_key_not_configured: The active model vendor has no API key. Edit src-tauri/resources/config.json and restart.
console.skills_desc: Tools and skills registered in the in-process agent (via Tauri invoke).
console.skills_loading_desc: No skills yet. Add files under workspace skills/.
console.config_desc_invoke: Workspace, sampling, and MCP. See Models for providers.
console.config_edit_hint: Config source: src-tauri/resources/config.json (bundled with Tauri). Restart after editing.
console.models_desc: Configure vendor API keys and choose the active chat model.
console.models_edit_hint: Credentials are saved to src-tauri/resources/config.json and apply immediately.
console.models_api_key_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the existing key
console.models_save_failed: Save failed. Check the key or file permissions.
console.models_clear_confirm_msg: This removes the API key and base URL for this provider.
console.models_readonly_vendor: This provider cannot be configured in the console yet
console.session_list_hint: No saved sessions yet. Send a message or start a new chat to create one.
console.memory_desc: Browse agent memory files and content.
console.knowledge_desc: Browse and explore your knowledge base.
console.knowledge_empty_hint: No knowledge pages yet. Use Upload Documents for PDF/Word, or add Markdown under workspace knowledge/.
console.knowledge_select_hint: Select a document on the left to view
console.channels_dev_desc: Single-channel dev mode: configure this channel only (preset via launch script).
console.channels_dev_unknown: Unknown channel "{{channel}}"; check NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_CHANNEL / launch script.
console.channels_add_desc: Pick a channel and enter credentials; saved to config.json
console.channels_all_connected: All available channels are already connected
console.channels_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this channel? Config is kept but the channel will stop.
console.channels_empty_desc: Click Connect above to get started
console.channels_config_hint: Channels are managed by the local SupportFlow Agent Python process (config.json + channel threads). Desktop agent chat still uses Rust.
console.channels_python_unreachable_hint: Run pnpm run build:channel-sidecar, or set CHANNEL_SIDECAR_EXE to the channel_agent-channels binary.
console.channel_hint_weixin: Official WeChat ilink bot; QR login. Desktop saves config only until QR flow is ported.
console.channel_hint_wx: itchat web protocol; account risk; testing only.
console.channel_hint_wework: Requires Windows + WeCom PC 4.0.8.6027; sign in to WeCom before connecting.
console.weixin_scan_desc: Scan the QR code below with WeChat
console.weixin_qr_tip: QR code expires in about 2 minutes
console.wecom_scan_desc: Scan with WeCom to create a smart bot in one step
console.feishu_scan_desc: Scan with Feishu to auto-create an app with permissions
console.feishu_scan_replace_desc: Scan to create a new bot; overwrites current App ID / Secret
console.wework_connect_note: Open and sign in to WeCom desktop first, keep it running, then tap Connect.
console.wework_connect_path_hint: Default path is usually fine; change only if you have multiple installs.
console.logs_coming_msg: The log stream will be available here soon. It will connect to run.log like tail -f.
